content.class.visitor.blurb: 你上岛来看那座礼拜堂，可船就要开了。赶在它离岸之前，跑到栈桥尽头去。
content.class.visitor.name: 访客
content.obj.the-boat.end-of-the-jetty.hint: 从石盖板下的高台上跳下去，再沿着栈桥一直走到最远的那一头。
content.obj.the-boat.end-of-the-jetty.title: 走到栈桥尽头
content.obj.the-wall-walk.cross-the-wall-walk.hi: 出了院门，助跑，一个缺口一个缺口地跳，跳上那座高台。
content.quest.the-boat.goal: 走到栈桥尽头，船在那儿等着。
content.quest.the-wall-walk.goal: 从院门离开礼拜堂的院子，一个缺口一个缺口地跳过断掉的墙头步道，到栈桥去。
content.world.boundary.message: 再往外，海水太冷，海面也太宽了。你掉头游回岛上。
content.world.outro: 船从栈桥边撑开，岛上的礼拜堂在你身后越退越远。
content.world.title: 离开地图的两条路

source.class.visitor.blurb: You came to the rock to see the chapel, and the boat is leaving. Get to the end of the jetty before it goes.
source.class.visitor.name: Visitor
source.obj.the-boat.end-of-the-jetty.hint: Leap down off the high platform, under the lid, and walk out to the far end of the jetty.
source.obj.the-boat.end-of-the-jetty.title: Walk to the end of the jetty
source.obj.the-wall-walk.cross-the-wall-walk.hi: Through the yard gate, run and leap each gap to the high platform.
source.obj.the-wall-walk.cross-the-wall-walk.ti: Leap to the high platform under the lid
source.quest.the-boat.goal: Walk out to the end of the jetty, where the boat waits.
source.quest.the-wall-walk.goal: Leave the chapel yard by its gate and cross the broken wall-walk, leaping each gap, to the jetty.
source.world.boundary.message: The sea is too cold and too wide out there. You turn back to the rock.
source.world.outro: The boat pushes off from the jetty, and the chapel on the rock falls away behind you.
source.world.title: Two Ways Off the Map
